name: Exp_BlauCSI
summary: This EA trades based on the BlauCSI (Blau CSI - Cumulative Swings Index) custom indicator, which applies triple-smoothed momentum calculations. It supports two entry modes: breakdown (zero-line crossover) and twist (direction change), and manages both long and short positions with configurable stop loss and take profit.
summary_zh: 该EA基于BlauCSI自定义指标进行交易，该指标采用三重平滑动量计算。它支持两种入场模式：突破（零线穿越）和转向（方向改变），并通过可配置的止损和止盈管理多头和空头仓位。
strategy_analysis: 该EA使用William Blau的CSI（累积摆动指标）作为核心交易信号源，CSI是对两组价格常数之间的动量进行三重平滑处理后得到的指标。策略概念基于动量方向变化或零线穿越来捕捉趋势的起始和反转。入场条件有两种模式：breakdown模式中，当CSI值从负变正时开多仓，从正变负时开空仓；twist模式中，当CSI从下降转为上升时开多仓，从上升转为下降时开空仓。出场条件包括反向信号触发平仓以及固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理方面，支持多种资金管理模式，包括基于可用保证金、账户余额、亏损比例或固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制每笔交易占用的资金比例，MMMode参数决定具体的计算方式。EA还使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线周期只计算一次信号，避免重复交易，同时通过SignalBar参数允许使用当前K线或已完成K线的信号。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses William Blau's CSI (Cumulative Swings Index) as its core trading signal source, which is derived from triple-smoothed momentum calculated between two price constants. The strategy concept is based on capturing trend initiation and reversal through momentum direction changes or zero-line crossovers. Entry conditions operate in two modes: in breakdown mode, a long position opens when CSI crosses above zero and a short position opens when it crosses below zero; in twist mode, a long opens when CSI shifts from declining to rising and a short opens when it shifts from rising to declining. Exit conditions include closing on opposing signals and using fixed stop loss and take profit levels specified in points. Position sizing supports multiple money management modes including free margin-based, balance-based, loss-fraction-based, and fixed lot sizing. The EA employs an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signal calculation happens only once per bar cycle, preventing duplicate trades, while the SignalBar parameter allows using either the current bar or a confirmed bar for signal generation.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 每笔交易占用的资金比例，负值表示固定手数
parameters.description_en: Capital fraction per trade; negative value for fixed lots

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 手数计算方法：可用保证金/余额/亏损比例/固定手数
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation: free margin/balance/loss ratio/fixed lot

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大允许价格滑点（点数）
parameters.description_en: Max allowed price slippage in points

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: 入场算法：breakdown(零线突破)或twist(方向改变)
parameters.description_en: Entry algorithm: breakdown (zero-line) or twist (direction change)

parameters.name: XPhase
parameters.description: 平滑参数（用于JMA等自适应方法）
parameters.description_en: Smoothing parameter (for JMA and adaptive methods)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线编号（0=当前K线，1=已完成K线）

pros: 三重平滑处理有效过滤市场噪音，信号质量较高
提供两种入场模式（突破和转向），适应不同市场环境
使用IsNewBar机制避免同根K线重复开仓，逻辑严谨
资金管理模式多样化，支持不同风险偏好的交易者
止损止盈设置完整，提供基本风险保护
pros_en: Triple smoothing effectively filters market noise, producing higher quality signals
Two entry modes (breakdown and twist) adapt to different market conditions
IsNewBar mechanism prevents duplicate trades within the same bar, ensuring logical rigor
Diverse money management modes accommodate traders with different risk preferences
Complete stop loss and take profit settings provide basic risk protection
cons: 依赖iCustom调用外部指标'BlauCSI'，若指标文件缺失则EA无法运行
没有点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能导致不必要的亏损
止损止盈为固定点数，未考虑市场波动性（ATR）动态调整
没有持仓检查逻辑，可能在已有同方向仓位时重复开仓
SignalBar=0时使用未完成K线信号，可能导致信号反复变化
cons_en: Depends on iCustom calling external 'BlauCSI' indicator; EA fails if the indicator file is missing
No spread filter, which may cause unnecessary losses in high-spread environments
Stop loss and take profit use fixed points without ATR-based dynamic adjustment for volatility
No existing position check logic, potentially opening duplicate positions in the same direction
Using SignalBar=0 reads unconfirmed bar data, which can cause signal flickering
improvements: 添加ATR动态止损止盈功能，使风险管理适应市场波动性
增加持仓检查和同方向仓位限制，避免重复开仓
增加点差过滤和交易时间过滤，提升交易质量
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss/take profit to adapt risk management to market volatility
Add position check and same-direction position limits to prevent duplicate entries
Add spread filter and trading session filter to improve trade quality

risk_points: 依赖外部指标文件，若缺失会导致初始化失败且无法交易
固定点数止损止盈在不同波动环境下可能不合理
缺乏同方向重复开仓检查，可能过度暴露风险
risk_points_en: Dependency on external indicator file; missing file causes initialization failure and inability to trade
Fixed-point stop loss/take profit may be inappropriate under varying volatility conditions
Lack of same-direction duplicate position check may lead to excessive risk exposure
